QuestInfo.name: Investigating the Package
QuestInfo.0: Ryden wants to look into a few more things regarding the Dark Lord
QuestInfo.1: Ryden wants to know the details about the package the Dark Lord gets every week. Go see Duey, wait, no, Huey, who handles the deliveries. #bGo to Perion and talk to Huey. Stealthily snatch the contents of the Delivery Package and return to The Secret Garden#k.
QuestInfo.2: You snuck out the contents of the Delivery Package to bring to Ryden and it's...a history book? What could the Dark Lord want with so many history books?!

1.0: The Dark Lord's package... Don't mind if I do...

yes.0: A book? About...history? How dreadfully ordinary. We'll have to analyze this and get it back to the Dark Lord before he realizes it's missing. I'll handle that part.

item.0: Your mission awaits you in Perion.
